items.title: Election review a 'hyper-partisan witch-hunt', Coalition says
items.description: A Coalition group has launched an extraordinary attack on one of parliament's top committees, slamming its election inquiry as biased.

items.title: Chopper pilot and police officer honoured for heroic Katherine flood rescue
items.description: A helicopter pilot and a police officer who performed a daring flood rescue in Katherine earlier this year have been awarded for their heroics as part of the Northern Territory's Territory Day awards.

items.title: Trump tries to claim a win on birthright citizenship Supreme Court ruling
items.description: While it's a blow to the US president, the highest court's narrow ruling may have emboldened efforts to overturn birthright citizenship through other avenues.

items.title: Comedian says 'terrifying' roadside assistance encounter has easy solution
items.description: Comedian Laura Johnston calls for changes to the law after saying she was confronted by an NRMA contractor who could not provide identification, behaved aggressively and swore at her before leaving her stranded in remote NSW.

items.title: Trump's financial disclosure reveals $US1.4 billion in crypto earnings
items.description: Donald Trump's financial disclosure included $US370,000 in income from gifts and $US80 million from settlements tied to lawsuits.

items.title: Murder case throws Thai sex tourism hub into global spotlight
items.description: Pattaya has become the centre of international attention after an Australian allegedly murdered a teenage girl, but it has had an international reputation for decades.

items.title: Ex-NSW premier's brothers, fugitive developer facing ICAC probe over donations
items.description: Allegations against a former NSW premier's brothers, a fugitive developer and Sydney councillors are the centre of ICAC hearings.

items.title: Australian spy agency spars with China over foreign interference claim
items.description: China's ambassador to Australia attacks ASIO over allegations of foreign interference aired in a video played at an agency event.

items.title: In Australia, if you can't play the property game you lose
items.description: If you've been wondering how and why Australian house prices spun out of control you're not alone. One filmmaker was so depressed by it he went out and shot a documentary.

items.title: Trillionaire Elon Musk called out at royal commission for antisemitism on X
items.description: An online hate prevention charity which monitors and reports antisemitic content says trillionaire Elon Musk is partly to blame for anti-Jewish hatred on social media platform X.

items.title: President Trump Announces U.S. Military Airstrike in Venezuela
items.description: President Trump states the U.S. military conducted its first known airstrike inside Venezuela targeting a dock where drugs were allegedly loaded onto boats[1][2][4].

items.title: Trump Meets Netanyahu at Mar-a-Lago for Gaza Ceasefire Phase Two Talks
items.description: President Trump met with Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu to discuss advancing phase two of the Gaza ceasefire, including reconstruction and responses to Iran[1][4].

items.title: Feds Launch Massive Taxpayer Fraud Probe in Minnesota After Viral Video
items.description: Federal agencies including DHS, FBI, and ICE investigate $110 million in suspected fraud at Minnesota child care centers following a viral YouTube video[3].

items.title: Americans Express Widespread Opposition to AI Data Centers
items.description: Public backlash against AI infrastructure data centers grows, with protests and demands for bans influencing Democratic Party strategies for future elections[3].

items.title: Elon Musk's Humanoid Robot Vision: China Poised to Lead Production
items.description: China prioritizes humanoid robots in tech race with U.S., ramping up production while warning of industry bubble and potential bottlenecks[3].

items.title: Trump-Putin Call Amid Ukraine-Russia Tensions Over Peace Plan
items.description: President Trump spoke with Putin amid ongoing Ukraine conflict, with Russia reevaluating peace plan tenets after Ukrainian denials[1].

items.title: Democratic Gubernatorial Candidates in Wisconsin Focus on Inflation and Trump
items.description: Seven Democrats vying for Wisconsin governor blame economic issues on Trump and emphasize affordability ahead of 2026 primary[3].
